request: Pull top-level monthly federal outlay totals from the Treasury Fiscal Data Monthly Treasury Statement (Table 5) for calendar years 2018-2025, run trend analysis with year-over-year change, rolling baselines and z-score anomalies, and publish to a 'Prep Agent / 01 - Federal Outlays' project on Tableau Server for finance analysts to track spending trends across the federal classification hierarchy.

sources.name: Treasury MTS Table 5 Outlays
sources.description: U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data API - Monthly Treasury Statement Table 5 (Receipts and Outlays of the U.S. Government by Department, Agency, and Function). Filtered to top-level rollup rows (sequence_level_nbr=1) for clean department/function totals and to calendar years 2018-2025 for an 8-year monthly series. Public, keyless, JSON:API style (page[number]/page[size] pagination).

args.name: Outlay Trend
args.features_description: Adds row-level temporal features parsed from record_date: year, month, quarter, fiscal_year, day_of_week, iso_week. Pure pass-through, no per-class statistics rolled into the row.
args.stats_description: Long-form monthly outlay statistics by federal classification: monthly_count (rows per dim/value/year/month), 90-day rolling counts, year-over-year deltas with pct change, z-score anomalies vs lifetime baseline (|z|>=2.5 flagged is_anomaly=True), and lifetime rank/pct_of_total to identify the highest-spend classifications.

outputs.name: Federal Outlays Detail
outputs.description: Row-level federal monthly outlay records (one row per Treasury MTS Table 5 top-level rollup row) with calendar features added: year, month, quarter, fiscal_year, day_of_week, iso_week. Use for transactional rollups in Tableau. Source: Treasury Fiscal Data Monthly Treasury Statement Table 5 (calendar years 2018-2025). Refresh: monthly.

outputs.name: Federal Outlays Stats
outputs.description: Long-form federal monthly outlay statistics (one row per classification_desc x year x month) with 90-day rolling counts, year-over-year deltas + percent change, lifetime rank/pct_of_total, baseline mean/std, and z-score anomalies (|z| >= 2.5 flagged is_anomaly=True). Joinable from Tableau on (classification_desc, year, month). Source: Treasury Fiscal Data MTS Table 5. Refresh: monthly.
